help.title: Help center
help.faq1Q: How do I track my order?
help.faq1A: Go to My Orders and tap on any order to see its real-time tracking status. You'll also get push notifications at every step.
help.faq2A: Standard delivery takes 2-3 days within Kathmandu Valley. Express delivery is available same-day for orders placed before 2 PM.
help.faq3A: Yes! You can return most products within 7 days of delivery. Go to your order, tap 'Return' and follow the steps. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days.
help.faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
help.faq4A: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Khalti, and eSewa. You can manage your payment methods in Profile > Payment Methods.
help.faq5Q: How do I get a refund?
help.faq5A: Refunds are automatically processed when a return is approved. For COD orders, we'll transfer to your Khalti/eSewa wallet. For online payments, the refund goes back to the original payment method.
help.faq6Q: How do I change my phone number?
help.faq6A: Go to Settings > Change phone number. You'll need to verify the new number with an OTP code.
help.faq7Q: How do I delete my account?
help.faq7A: Go to Settings > Delete account. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data including orders, wishlist, and addresses will be removed.
help.faq8Q: Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
help.faq8A: COD is available in Kathmandu Valley and major cities. For other areas, we recommend using Khalti or eSewa for a smoother experience.

about.title: About Chinooz
about.description: Chinooz is Nepal's trusted marketplace connecting you with thousands of local sellers. From electronics to handicrafts, groceries to fashion — everything you need, delivered to your doorstep.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Chinooz, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.
terms.s3Body: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation. Prices are displayed in Nepali Rupees (NPR) and include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to cancel orders in case of pricing errors or stock unavailability.
terms.s4Body: Delivery times are estimates and may vary. Chinooz is not liable for delays caused by factors beyond our control. Risk of loss transfers to you upon delivery.
terms.s5Body: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Certain items (perishables, personal care, underwear) are non-returnable. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after return approval.
terms.s6Body: You may not use Chinooz for any unlawful purpose, to resell products without authorization, to manipulate prices or reviews, or to harass other users or sellers.
terms.s7Body: Chinooz acts as a marketplace platform. We are not liable for the quality, safety, or legality of products listed by sellers. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the relevant order.
terms.s8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Chinooz after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly: name, phone number, email, delivery address, and payment details. We also collect usage data such as pages visited, searches, and device information.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to process orders, provide customer support, improve our platform, send order updates and promotional messages (with your consent), and prevent fraud.
privacy.s3Body: We share your information with sellers (to fulfill orders), delivery partners (to deliver your orders), and payment processors (to process payments). We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Body: You can access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings. You can also opt out of promotional messages.
privacy.s6Body: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.s7Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@chinooz.com or through the Contact Us page in the app.
